Technical SEO.title: Google November Core Update Complete, December Core Update Preannounced
Technical SEO.summary: The Google November 2026 core update has completed and Google has preannounced a December 2026 core update that is not yet live. Google also launched a new search ranking hub covered in the same recap.

Technical SEO.title: Google Moves 404 Guidance To Search Central, Adds A 410 Crawl Note
Technical SEO.summary: Google relocated its 404 guidance into Search Central and clarified that 410 status codes are generally crawled less often than 404s, while both are treated the same for indexing purposes.

Technical SEO.title: Google On When To Fix 404 Errors and Updates 404 and Sitemaps Docs
Technical SEO.summary: Google updated its troubleshooting crawling errors help document and its sitemap help document, with the most notable change being new guidance on whether to fix 404 errors flagged in Search Console.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Know What To Fix Before Scaling AI Agents For AEO In 2027
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An upcoming webinar aimed at enterprise teams covers where AI agent programs stall and how to prioritize AEO data, measurement, and investment decisions heading into 2027.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Paid Search Has An AI Blind Spot - IAB Blueprint Says A Claim Is Not Credit
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The IAB has released a blueprint arguing that paid search may be claiming credit for conversions that AI assistants actually influenced, and it outlines four steps to test this attribution gap in Google Ads.

AI Search / GEO.title: Bing AI Mode Ads Blending More With Organic Results
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft Advertising is making it increasingly difficult to distinguish paid ads from organic results within Bing AI Mode, continuing a longstanding pattern of ad-organic blending now extending into AI and Copilot Search surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: This data study examines which domains are most frequently cited by major AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, offering a reference point for GEO competitive analysis.

AI Search / GEO.title: Copilot Has Ads From Microsoft Advertising
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft is serving ads powered by Microsoft Advertising inside Copilot responses, signaling that AI answer surfaces are now active commercial environments that intersect with organic visibility strategy.
